_comment: GitHub Ruleset for the default branch. Apply via: gh api repos/:owner/:repo/rulesets --method POST --input .github/rulesets/main-protection.json. Replaces classic branch protection. | e2e-audit ci-gates-1: every unfiltered per-PR gate is REQUIRED (adr-gate, commitlint incl. lint-trailers, lint-exception-audit, check-daily-batch=merge-gate). Path-filtered gates (claude-review, claude-security, pr-review) stay ADVISORY by decision - they don't run on every PR, so requiring them would block docs-only merges. | AUTONOMOUS-MERGE (operator decision 2026-07-24): required_approving_review_count=0 and require_code_owner_review=false so an agent can self-merge on all-green CI (the agent's own reviewer+security jobs ARE the review). The 9 required status checks remain the hard gate: no green, no merge. required_signatures REMOVED because agent/CI commits are not GPG-signed and it would block every autonomous merge; re-add it only if you sign agent commits.
name: main-protection
